def solve(I):
    from collections import Counter as C
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # find rects via background-color regions... simpler: find bounding boxes of non-background colors, where bg = most common color
    cnt=C(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=[];vis=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bg and not vis[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)];vis[i][j]=True;cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop();cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not vis[x][y] and I[x][y]==I[a][b]:
                            vis[x][y]=True;st.append((x,y))
                rs=[c[0] for c in cells];cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                comps.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in comps:
        h=r1-r0+1;w=c1-c0+1
        inner=[(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1)

        # apply only when rect has both dimensions >=3? check on 6-wide block: got changed. fine, no inner here anyway

        return None
    return None
